prompts.plaster.png: Use case: stylized-concept. Produce one square opaque edge-to-edge material swatch, an orthographic flat albedo texture of the warm cream aged lime plaster from the wall bays of the attached A cottage design (style/material reference only). Storybook hand-painted gouache with broad cloudy ivory and honey cream brushwork, only a couple of faint large worn strokes and tiny shallow broken hairlines at very low contrast. Quiet and readable under game lighting at 25 degrees, smoothly tileable edges. Absolute flat illumination, no directional shadows, no masonry, no wood, no window, no vignette, no labels, no border, no illustration of a house.
prompts.ivy.png: Use case: illustration-story. One isolated narrow hanging ivy sprig for the front wall of an original cottage game. Match the hand-painted storybook art, broad outlined brushshapes and softly shaded olive/sage greens from the attached A cottage style reference. Full silhouette, transparent background. It attaches at upper right and hangs in a loose gentle S down toward the left, one clear slender stem with 14–20 alternating broad ivy leaves, two tiny offshoots, wider up top and tapering at bottom. Front elevation, left and right sides all visible, roughly 1:2.7 silhouette, readable in 80 screen pixels, soft ambient light. No wall, frame, cast shadow, pot, flowers, label or background.
prompts.window-box.png: Use case: illustration-story. One isolated full window box sprite, transparent background, modeled on the window boxes in the attached original A cottage design (style/prop reference). Rustic long warm brown wood trough with two muted dark supports, clustered cream daisy heads with ochre centers and olive leaves, one short spray of leaves drooping off the right corner. Large coherent leaf and petal shapes, softly edged shaded storybook gouache, restrained detail for a 110 pixel-wide game object. Front camera with 25 degree downward tilt, show the front plank and a little top rim, no yaw; soft ambient light. Roughly 3:1 width to height. No wall, glass, window, ground, detached shadow, text, labels or backdrop. Entire box isolated with transparent padding.
prompts.planters.png: Use case: illustration-story. Two isolated cottage planter sprites on one transparent sprite sheet, separated by a generous empty vertical gutter and margins, same foot height. Match attached A cottage design's game prop illustration style and the exact left and right entrance planter ideas: LEFT ochre honey-brown glazed rounded crock with a carved pale leaf band, cream daisies with golden centers in large readable groups; RIGHT warm ivory pottery urn with a restrained carved leaf medallion and broad moss-olive leaves, no blossoms. Hand-painted warm storybook gouache, broad shaded color shapes and subtle brush texture. For fixed 25 degree down camera from directly in front: see elliptical rims and tops of leaves with no side rotation. Soft ambient light, no harsh cast shadow or floor, no background, no text. Both full silhouettes uncropped.
